title: createStockLocations - Stock Location Next Module Reference

blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `createStockLocations` method. This belongs to the Stock Location Next Module.
You should only use this methods when implementing complex customizations. For common cases, check out [available workflows instead](/medusa-workflows-reference).
This method creates a stock location.
